records.primary_competencies: Ownership; technical depth; problem solving; Leadership-Principle-aligned behaviors
records.conversation_themes: Project deep dive; ML breadth; science application design; LP stories with metrics
records.opening_prompt: Tell me about a machine learning or software project you owned end to end - the problem, your approach, and the outcome.
records.followup_strategy: Adaptive: probe baseline, measurement, alternatives, personal contribution, deployment outcome (generated); LP follow-ups with what-if scenarios (reported pattern, adjacent SDE-1 loops)
records.evaluation_criteria: Competency-based; STAR + metrics expected (official)
records.technical_context: DSA coding + ML theory + mini ML system design
records.evidence_basis: Official loop guide + official Applied Science process + 2 adjacent SDE-1 loops + 2 adjacent Applied Scientist reports (EXP-N05/06/07, EXP-V-AMAZON-AI01/02). NO exact AI/ML Engineer report: behavioral/LP emphasis is well-evidenced company-wide; technical format is adjacent-role - do NOT present SDE-1 evidence as an AI/ML Engineer template.
records.generation_status: generated - provisional
records.interview_objective: Discover how the candidate frames problems, owns outcomes, and reasons technically, Amazon-loop style.
records.question_intent: An open project narrative surfaces threads worth probing (contribution, decisions, metrics) before any technical exercise.
records.expected_evidence: Specific problem framing; personal contribution stated with "I"; measurable outcome with baseline; design trade-offs; LP-aligned behaviors (ownership, customer impact) with metrics.
records.probe_dimensions: Baseline vs result; measurement method; alternatives considered; individual vs team contribution; deployment and post-deployment outcome.
records.adaptive_triggers: Vague metrics -> ask for baseline and how it was measured; "we" language -> ask for personal contribution; model described without problem context -> ask why the problem mattered; deployment claimed -> ask what happened after deployment and how it was monitored.
records.insufficient_answer_strategy: Narrow the scope: ask for one concrete example, one metric, or one decision with its reasoning.
records.strong_answer_strategy: Raise difficulty: scale the problem (more data/users), add constraints (latency, cost), or ask for failure modes and monitoring.
records.contradiction_strategy: Surface the inconsistency neutrally and ask the candidate to reconcile it (e.g. claimed ownership vs described team execution).
records.time_budget: 55-60 min: ~15 project deep dive, ~20 technical exercise, ~15 behavioral/LP, ~5 candidate questions
records.evidence_confidence: medium-low for AI/ML-specific behavior (adjacent-role evidence only); high for LP/behavioral emphasis (official)

records.primary_competencies: Statistical reasoning; product sense; communication
records.conversation_themes: Statistics deep dive; open-ended product analytics; metrics coding
records.opening_prompt: How would you measure whether a new feature is working for users?
records.followup_strategy: Adaptive: push from formula to intuition ("WHY the t-distribution?") (reported pattern, EXP-N18)
records.evaluation_criteria: Competency-based; intuition over formulas (reported)
records.technical_context: Statistics + SQL/Python + product case
records.evidence_basis: 1 detailed DS loop report (EXP-N18, exact) + 1 DS process-consensus thread (EXP-N19) + 1 adjacent L4 MLE report (EXP-V-GOOGLE-DA01). Confidence-interval scenario grounded in EXP-N18.
records.generation_status: generated - provisional
records.interview_objective: Discover whether the candidate reasons statistically under ambiguity and connects analysis to product decisions.
records.question_intent: An open measurement question reveals whether the candidate thinks in hypotheses, metrics and trade-offs rather than formulas.
records.expected_evidence: Clear metric definition; awareness of variance/uncertainty; experimental or quasi-experimental design; product trade-off reasoning; plain-language explanation.
records.probe_dimensions: Metric choice; statistical rigor (distributions, power, multiple comparisons); product sense; communication of uncertainty.
records.adaptive_triggers: Formula recited without intuition -> ask WHY that distribution/test; metric named without guardrails -> ask what could go wrong; case answer without data -> ask what data they would need.
records.insufficient_answer_strategy: Ask for a concrete small-scale example or a simplified case before generalizing.
records.strong_answer_strategy: Add complications: multiple metrics conflict, experiment underpowered, stakeholder disagrees with the result.
records.contradiction_strategy: Point at the tension (e.g. significance claimed but interval too wide) and ask them to resolve it.
records.time_budget: 45 min: ~15 statistics deep dive, ~15 product analytics case, ~10 coding/metrics, ~5 wrap-up
records.evidence_confidence: medium (1 detailed exact-role loop + consensus thread; limited independent corroboration)

records.primary_competencies: Role expertise (NLP/DL range); ownership; collaboration
records.conversation_themes: Coding + ML basics; DL/NLP specialization; project deep dive; classical system design
records.opening_prompt: Walk me through the ML project you consider most impactful - the problem, your approach, and the business outcome.
records.followup_strategy: Adaptive: resume-bullet probing with metrics and business impact (reported); design under constraints (reported)
records.evaluation_criteria: Competency-based; scalable thinking for DS
records.technical_context: DP coding + DL/NLP + system design (incl. a reported pre-LLM constraint variant)
records.evidence_basis: 1 exact Senior DS report with a detailed 5-round loop (EXP-N24) + 2 exact senior MLE reports (EXP-N25/26) + 2 adjacent reports (EXP-V-WALMAR-DA01/02). NOTE: one candidate reported resume deep dive was "~20% of every round" (EXP-N24) - a single report, NOT a general rule; do not state it as fact or put it in an opening.
records.generation_status: generated - provisional
records.interview_objective: Discover depth across the DS craft (classical ML through DL/NLP) and ownership of production outcomes at senior level.
records.question_intent: The project narrative tests whether claimed impact survives probing on metrics, monitoring and architecture choices.
records.expected_evidence: End-to-end ownership; quantitative impact; architecture rationale (incl. classical vs LLM trade-offs); monitoring/drift awareness; honest accounting of failures.
records.probe_dimensions: Resume bullets with metrics; model/architecture choices; business impact; cross-team collaboration; failure modes.
records.adaptive_triggers: Impact claimed without numbers -> ask for the metric and baseline; buzzword stacking (RAG/LLM) -> ask for internals (attention, embeddings, evaluation); design too clean -> ask what broke in production.
records.insufficient_answer_strategy: Request one specific decision and its alternatives, or one incident and what changed after.
records.strong_answer_strategy: Strip modern tooling: ask them to solve the problem WITHOUT LLMs (reported pre-LLM design variant) or under latency/cost constraints.
records.contradiction_strategy: Contrast two claims (e.g. "I owned the model" vs described team delivery) and ask them to walk through who did what.
records.time_budget: 60 min: ~10 coding, ~20 ML/DL depth, ~15 project deep dive, ~10 design, ~5 wrap-up
records.evidence_confidence: medium (3 exact-role reports, all senior; entry/mid-level behavior unevidenced)

records.interview_objective: Discover algorithmic problem solving, design fundamentals AND real ML depth - the reported loop weights a long hiring-manager ML project debate.
records.question_intent: An ML-decisions narrative lets Suri pick the debate threads the hiring-manager round is reported to emphasize (approach, personal role, challenges solved).
